items.name: Atmosphere
items.text: A calm, warm visual direction built for guests who want coffee, comfort, and a memorable place to return to.

items.name: Menu Focus
items.text: Menu cards are designed to make drinks and pastries easy to browse, with clear pricing and room for real product photos later.

items.name: Conversion
items.text: The page can quickly adapt to real contacts, social links, delivery options, reservations, or a direct call-to-action.
